background.text: Patron saints: The apostles Peter and Paul (feast 29 June)
Government: Papal monarchy. Leo X, Giovanni de' Medici, reigned 1513 to 1521; Leonardo's protector was the pope's brother Giuliano de' Medici, who died in March 1516
Terrain and water: The lower Tiber; to the south the malarial Pontine marshes; the outer port at Civitavecchia

Economy: A city of consumption organized around jubilees, indulgences, and the redistribution of church revenue; the concentration of clergy, bankers, and pilgrims from all Europe formed the largest patronage market of the peninsula
